name: website-improvement-loop
description: Audit, improve, test, ideate, and build website features with quality bar enforcement

scripts.verify: npm run lint:json && npm run lint:bash && npm run lint:mjs
scripts.lint:json: for f in $(find . -name '*.json' -not -path './node_modules/*'); do node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$f'))" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint:bash: for f in $(find . -name '*.sh' -not -path './node_modules/*'); do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint:mjs: for f in $(find . -name '*.mjs' -not -path './node_modules/*'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
